WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rental_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rental_price) AS cross_avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_stats
),
above_average_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.rating,
    rs.avg_replacement_cost,
    rs.avg_daily_rental_price,
    cra.cross_avg_daily_price,
    rs.avg_daily_rental_price - cra.cross_avg_daily_price AS excess
  FROM rating_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN cross_rating_avg cra
  WHERE rs.avg_daily_rental_price > cra.cross_avg_daily_price
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_costs,
  AVG(avg_daily_rental_price) AS avg_daily_prices,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_price
FROM above_average_ratings
